summary.text: Evan Worrell is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 23 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Evan Worrell lives in Barboursville, West Virginia, and studied at Marshall University.
His career experience includes working as a healthcare reform and information technology consultant with Cerner Corporation.
